actual.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(valid_order_count) AS valid_order_count
  , SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
FROM (
  SELECT
    channel AS order__channel
    , CASE WHEN case when status = 'paid' and paid_cents - refund_cents > 0 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS valid_order_count
    , case when status = 'paid' then paid_cents - refund_cents else 0 end AS net_sales_cents
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_5
WHERE order__channel in ('小程序')
actual.question: 2026年8月青禾小程序渠道的有效订单数和净销售额分别是多少?
